brief:
The Israeli military announced it will prevent Palestinians with work permits from entering settlements in the occupied West Bank on Sunday and Monday, Middle East Eye reported. Only workers in industrial zones and other designated areas will be allowed entry during the restriction period.

The measure affects Palestinians who hold legal permits to work in the territory, limiting their access to employment opportunities in settlements during the two-day closure.
dek: Israel restricts entry of Palestinian labourers to West Bank areas Israeli army has said Palestinians with work permits will be barred from settlements in the occupied West Bank, except industrial zones and other approved areas, on Sunday and Monday.
title: Israel bars Palestinian workers from West Bank settlements two days
